Shadow the Scene · Reto 1 · The long way home

Reto Reductions

Cómo hacerlo

Escoge 6 de las 12 oraciones de la escena y graba un video de máximo 2 minutos donde se vea tu cara y tu boca leyéndolas. Antes de grabar, practica con los audios: toca Normal y Lento, escucha y repite en voz alta hasta que te sientas cómodo.

Postea tu video en el feed de la comunidad con el hashtag #ChallengeReductions
¿No sabes cómo? Mira aquí el video donde te explico paso a paso ▶

💬 Al publicar tu video en la comunidad, vas a recibir feedback para seguir mejorando.

Qué grabar

  1. Escoge 6 oraciones de la lista.
  2. Lee cada una 1 vez, imitando el ritmo y la entonación de la escena.

Escucha la escena

  • ▶Escena completa

Las oraciones

  • OraciónEscuchar
  • 1Our life in the United States on Cape Cod was honestly a dream.
  • 2The kind of life that most people would be lucky to have.
  • 3We lived at the end of a quiet dirt road in a private setting, in a big home, surrounded by nature.
  • 4There were ponds, long walks, playgrounds, carnivals.
  • 5We ran together. The kids raced and… so did we.
  • 6We spent our days at the beach and at ponds.
  • 7We had a playset, a trampoline, and yes, a pool because… why not?
  • 8We had it all, the American dream.
  • 9And as much as we love it there, something never quite clicked.
  • 10It wasn’t home. It was just a place that we built a nest.
  • 11And it wasn’t a bad place. It was a great place to raise kids.
  • 12But the world is big and we wanted to know if there was something more out there for us.
